name: Pikaswaps
description: Replace a region of a source video.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible generation. Defaults to a random seed.
seed.title: Seed

video.description: URL of the source video to edit.
video.title: Video

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the edit to apply.
prompt.title: Prompt

negative_prompt.description: Text describing what to avoid in the video.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

modify_region_roi.description: Free-text description of the region to replace. Provide this or a mask.
modify_region_roi.title: Modify Region Roi

modify_region_mask.description: URL of a mask image marking the region to replace. Provide this or an ROI.
modify_region_mask.title: Modify Region Mask

image.description: URL of a reference image for the replacement subject.
image.title: Image
